name: isambard
description: AI agent skills for Isambard HPC systems, plus a job watch to a read point, a Slurm queue mod (a line above the prompt, /queue, toasts, a short queue summary beside each prompt, live meters for cluster GPU load, the project's disk quota, this month's GPU node hours and the tunnel's time left), and two research subagents (repo-reader, library-surveyor)

tunnelName.title: Tunnel job name
tunnelName.description: The Slurm job name of the VS Code tunnel; it is shown apart from the other jobs with its time left, and a toast warns 30 minutes before it ends

context.title: Queue beside each prompt
context.description: on: a few lines of queue state go beside each prompt while jobs are queued, and one line when the queue drains; off: the model sees nothing unless it runs squeue

wake.title: Wake the model when its job ends
wake.description: on: when a job this session submitted leaves the queue, the model gets a prompt of its own (counts, last error line) and reads the result; off: an ended job is told once beside the next prompt you type

storagePath.title: Folder for the disk meter
storagePath.description: A folder on Lustre whose project quota the disk meter shows (lfs quota -p); empty: the folder the session works in
